As per the case of the prosecution, father of the prosecutrix lodged a missing person report of his daughter, thereafter she was recovered by the police and case was registered against the appellant.

opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
Prosecutrix had gone along with the appellant on her own will.
After being recovered, she was medically examined and no definite opinion was given about commission of offence.
Further, there is no DNA in the case.
Appellant has been convicted only because the prosecutrix was found to be below 16 years of age.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS: Appellant has no criminal antecedent and he was 21 years of age at the time of commission of offence.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
